subject: IRONMAN World Championship, Kailua-Kona, Hawaiʻi
status_note: Times as published by NBC Sports two days after the race, marked unofficial there. Replace with the official IRONMAN results when published; splits are not yet available from a source we could read.
editorial: KONA.m independent room. Results only; the room's taglines are KONA.m copy, not the athletes' words.

moments.line: Solveig Løvseth overtook Knibb with five miles left; on Palani Road, about a mile from the finish, she began to wobble and came to a stop with seven tenths of a mile to go. Taylor Knibb passed her in the final mile.
Vincent Luis started the marathon 5:34 behind Magnus Ditlev, passed him with just under five miles left and held off Gustav Iden by 95 seconds.
Gustav Iden served a three-minute drafting penalty on the bike.
